boards.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high-fidelity product design presentation, landscape 1536x1024, THREE equal large straight-on phone app screens. This is NutriGuide, a premium visual-first wellness app. The attached image is ONLY a reference for information architecture, rounded rectangular cards, clear large icons, typography and moon/horizon identity. Critically REJECT its nearly identical navy palettes. The user wants FULL-SCREEN, FULL-APPLICATION transformations with clearly different dominant colors visible even as tiny thumbnails. Every surface changes: screen background, headers, card fills, border colors, shadows, all UI icons, text foregrounds, primary action, selected AND unselected navigation, status bar. Not just colored accents over the same navy! Elegant calm, buildable with Flutter tokens and layered scenery, generous large icon-based tiles with short labels. No neon gaming aesthetic, no paragraphs.
Top outside board title "01 / Modun, bütün dünyayı değiştirir". Three short column headings: "Yorgunum", "Sakinim", "Enerjiğim".
LEFT home is a WARM PLUM world named velvet dusk. ALL background #241C2C warm aubergine; thick opaque matte mauve card fills #3B2E45 and #49384F; warm ivory #FFF1E7 text; pale peach champagne #E8C6AE icons/buttons. A soft fabric-like folded dune just in header, honey crescent, no blue or mint anywhere. Card shadows velvet soft, tactile yet simple. Headline "Bugün", small chip "Yorgunum", tiny line "Bugün azı da yeter." Small top NutriGuide, N circle. A wide food hero, warm natural chickpea bowl on right, text "Kolay bir tabak", "15 dk", button "Beslen", tiny circled i. Below 2x2 large rectangles: wave icon "Nefes" "2 dk", crescent "Uyku" "Hazırlan", walking icon "Hareket" "Kısa mola", drop "Su" "+250 ml". Short low-key action "Modu değiştir" at bottom above nav.
CENTER home is a DEEP JADE / PETROL GREEN world named still water. ALL background #0D3033, opaque teal card fill #19464A, subtle sea-glass edges, pale pearl #EDF8EE text, soft jade #B9DFCF buttons and ALL UI icons. Broad quiet liquid horizon in header and pearl crescent. Absolutely no navy background, no plum. Heading "Bugün", chip "Sakinim", tiny line "Kendi ritminde devam." SAME card layout, SAME food photo, hero "Bugünkü tabağın", "15 dk", "Beslen". SAME 2x2 cards and icon shapes/text as left. action "Modu değiştir".
RIGHT home is a LIGHT APRICOT / AMBER SUNRISE world. Background #FFF0DA, opaque peach cards #F8DAB8, pale sand #FFE5C7 header and nav, dark cacao #352318 ALL text and status/nav icons, burnt sienna #944523 primary action with pale text. Strongly different LIGHT warm palette, no dark blue panels, no white text on peach. Sunrise disc on curved dune horizon replaces moon, same celestial design family. Heading "Bugün", chip "Enerjiğim", tiny line "Bugüne alan aç." SAME food photo/hero and SAME 2x2 tile geometry and labels as center. Large flat bold warm brown icons, subtle tactile amber highlights, no busy sunburst. action "Modu değiştir".
Every phone has five bottom tabs EXACT labels "Bugün", "Keşfet", "Plan", "Gelişim", "Profil", identical icon shapes and locations, Bugün selected according to each full palette. No body charts or invented health scores. Every big tile has small circled i at top-right. Keep all content visible within screen without clipped nav. Consistent generous white space. Keep food itself natural colored, only its surface surroundings change. This is a concept illustration, not real app screenshots. Footer outside phones "Tasarım önerisi · Üç ayrı atmosfer, aynı kullanım düzeni". Accurate Turkish diacritics.
revisions: Use case: text-localization and precise UI edit. Edit this three-phone NutriGuide design board, preserving all imagery, color palettes, layout, typography, food, phone frames and other text exactly. Make ONLY these two semantic fixes: (1) In the rightmost column, change the outside column heading "Enerjiğim" and inside mood chip "Enerjiğim" to the correct concise Turkish label "Enerjik". (2) In the wide "Modu değiştir" row near the bottom of EACH of the three phones, replace the padlock icon with a simple sliders/tune icon matching the existing color and stroke weight. This action changes mood and is not locked or paid. Keep its label "Modu değiştir" unchanged. Do not change anything else. Preserve the strong whole-screen plum / jade / light apricot transformations.

Correct ONE text error in this existing design board. In the RIGHTMOST light apricot phone only, the large title directly below NutriGuide is malformed ("Bugüik"). It must read exactly "Bugün" — five characters B u g ü n — matching the large "Bugün" titles of the other two phones. Replace only that single title, same position, size, dark brown font and baseline. Freeze all remaining pixels as closely as possible: the other two screens, Enerjik headings/chip, every icon, photo, card, navigation, colors, and all other words must remain unchanged. No redesign.

High fidelity implementation-ready UI concept, not illustration-only concept art.

Use case: ui-mockup. NutriGuide immersive mood board03, landscape1536x1024, TWO large straight-on phone screens, same scale and slim premium frame. Reference shows three worlds; the LEFT phone in reference is the WARM PLUM fatigue world to use for the RIGHT phone of this new board. This board shows the experience from an explicit mood choice to an optional breathing break, NOT automatic session start. Crisp accurate Turkish lettering and large approachable visual cards with minimal text.
Outside board title "03 / Bir seçim, sana ait bir alan". LEFT column label "Modunu seç". RIGHT column label "Sonra, istersen bir mola". Elegant warm neutral background outside phones.
LEFT PHONE: neutral signature midnight navy #001426 before a mood has been chosen. Small NutriGuide top. Modest celestial horizon top, headline "Şu an nasılsın?" readable 30px, short helper "Seçimin görünümü ve önerileri değiştirir." Three full-width LARGE rectangular cards stacked, height about145 each, generous14 spacing, corner22. Each card is a miniature preview of its ENTIRE world: card1 matte plum velvet folds with big warm champagne crescent icon and bold white label "Yorgunum"; card2 opaque jade-green still-water world, huge pearl horizontal ripple glyph and white label "Sakinim"; card3 light apricot sunrise world with large burnt amber sun glyph and dark cacao label "Enerjik". Small chevron at right each, no radio buttons and no second Apply button: each entire card is the selection. Text is not buried in art, each has a solid quiet area. Bottom text button "Şimdi değil". No navigation bar on this one-time optional daily question. No fake therapist, no emojis or tiny icons.
RIGHT PHONE: the breathing tool after the user chose Yorgunum, visited home and tapped Nefes. ALL surfaces warm plum #241C2C / mauve #3B2E45, ivory #FFF1E7 text, champagne #E8C6AE accents; no leftover navy/mint/blue. Top back arrow, small heading "Nefes molası", circled i at right. Short mood chip "Yorgunum". Large title "Bir nefeslik ara". A LARGE central glowing champagne translucent soft loop, smooth matte blush/plum interior, feels like warm light resting on velvet. Contemporary restrained luminous material with one warm soft halo, no eye, no brain, no lungs, no blue globe. Center tiny legible text "Kendi ritminde". Below big timer "02:00". Short line "Nefesini zorlamadan." Broad filled champagne button with dark plum text "Başlat". Secondary "Şimdi değil". Small simple footer "Bugün azı da yeter." No automatic running timer, no fabricated physiological readings, no streak or guilt. No bottom nav on focused session screen. Same corner language and large touch targets as reference. Generous calm composition.
Outside footer "Tasarım önerisi · Seçim anında tema uygulanır, mola sen başlatınca başlar". Keep screens buildable and realistic, not a cinematic poster with unreadable UI.
